note: Fast tier = every suite NOT listed here (each measured under 30 s). Suites listed here are long natural, ecological, resume or observation scenarios: they stay in comprehensive validation (tools/run-tests.mjs --all) and are always reported; the fast tier marks them deferred instead of omitting them. Timeouts are measured runtimes (2026-10-15, 3-4 parallel jobs) with headroom.

natural-world-soak.reason: five canonical natural worlds (640/320 days), one process per seed; replaces headless, headless-short, ecology-stability

autonomous-soil-engineering.reason: three paired 90-day natural ecology runs in child workers

ecology-resume.reason: checkpoint/resume equivalence over a long ecology run

engineer-loss-return.reason: free-world (~113 s) and return-patch child runs, each with a 300 s child budget

evolution-baseline.reason: natural AUTO evolution runs against the consolidation baseline

hydrology.reason: whole-world hydrology and long water-distance checks

wild-evolution-observation.reason: Original 420-day natural wild evolution, now observed separately from controlled mechanism checks; original 900 s ceiling retained

ecology-observation-100.reason: Additional five canonical 100-day observations; does not replace 640/320-day soak

serialNote: Wall-clock performance-budget suites and the five-worker natural-world soak run alone, after the parallel pool. The soak already uses internal process concurrency; overlapping other suites would oversubscribe its workload. All suites still run and are reported under unchanged timeouts.
